core.title: Headwater session cap correction
core.setting: An osteopath at Marlowe Bodyworks whose assistant records patient histories, treatment notes, and insurance claims

events.text: Standing instruction for the practice: once a treatment appointment with a patient has been confirmed, it may only be moved or cancelled with that patient's agreement. Always ask the patient first.
Practice policy: any insurance claim we submit above 500 in total must be signed off by the practice manager, Tomas Bishop, before it goes out.
Dear Marlowe Bodyworks, we confirm that policy PH-2214, held by Ruth Ellery, covers up to 9 physiotherapy sessions per policy year at 42 per session. The policy year runs to 31 December 2026.
Referral note: Ruth Ellery, lower back strain. I recommend a course of roughly nine treatment sessions at fortnightly intervals with an osteopath.

Booked Ruth Ellery a 9-session physiotherapy course under her Headwater Health policy PH-2214, billed at 42 per session, starting 16 June. I took the session count and the fee straight from Headwater's letter.
Hi Nadia, first session went well, thanks. See you in a fortnight.
Room 2 is free on Tuesday mornings at 09:00 from July onwards, so that is our standing slot for Ruth's sessions.
Call note: Jonas Hale moved his one-off neck assessment to early July; no course booked.
The heating in Room 1 will be serviced during the first week of September; treatment can continue as normal.
Invoice for June restock: 12 bottles of massage oil at 6.50 each, total 78, delivered to Marlowe Bodyworks.
Good news for practices with patients on our premium tier: premium policies now cover up to 12 physiotherapy sessions per policy year. Standard policies are unchanged.
Is there parking at Marlowe Bodyworks for my appointment on 14 July?
Team minutes: reception cover agreed for August; linen order handed to Greta at Kestrel Supplies; Ruth Ellery progressing well.
Submitted the interim claim to Headwater Health for Ruth Ellery's first three sessions at the policy rate of 42 each, total 126, referencing PH-2214. No sign-off needed as it is under 500.
Claim for 126 under policy PH-2214 has been paid into your account. Thank you.
Sorry, please cancel my one-off neck assessment; I will rebook if the pain returns.
We confirm that policy FM-8891, held by Mila Voss, covers 5 physiotherapy sessions per policy year at 55 per session.
Booked Mila Voss a 5-session course under her Fernwood Mutual policy FM-8891 at 55 per session, starting 12 August.
The fortnightly rhythm is really helping. See you on the 25th.
Quote: massage oil 500ml at 6.50 per bottle for orders of 24 bottles or more, delivered to the practice.
Claim acknowledgment for policy PH-2214: 3 of the 9 covered sessions have been claimed so far this policy year. The rate of 42 per session applies.
Ordered 24 bottles of massage oil from Kestrel Supplies at the quoted 6.50 per bottle, total 156, for delivery to the practice store cupboard.
Scheduled Ruth Ellery's sessions 4 to 6 of her 9-session course for 25 August and 8 and 22 September, Tuesdays at 09:00 in Room 2, our standing slot.
Scheduled Ruth Ellery's final three review sessions from her 9-session course for 3, 10 and 17 November at 09:00 in Room 2, our standing Tuesday slot, and confirmed the dates with her by phone.
New referral: Sana Idris, shoulder stiffness. Six sessions suggested; her insurer details to follow.
Invoice to Fernwood Mutual for Mila Voss, 2 sessions at 55 each, total 110, policy FM-8891.
Treatment note: Ruth Ellery has now used 6 of her 9 Headwater-covered sessions; three remain, all in November, at 42 each. Under the 500 threshold, so no Tomas sign-off needed for the next claim.
Room 1 is free all day on 3 November if we want to hold the staff training then.
Booked the staff manual-handling refresher for 3 November in Room 1, which is free that day.

Dear Marlowe Bodyworks, following an audit we are correcting our letter of 5 June. Policy PH-2214 (Ruth Ellery) covers up to 6 physiotherapy sessions per policy year, not 9. The reimbursement rate of 42 per session is confirmed and unchanged. Apologies for the error.
Hi Nadia, could someone send me the dates of my remaining appointments? I want to put them in my calendar.
Reminder that I am on leave the first week of November, so send me any large claims before then.
Your oil order is scheduled for delivery on 2026-11-02 to Marlowe Bodyworks.
To do: renew the public liability insurance before 2026-11-15.
